text: DON'T USE THIS APP!!! I'd rate it -5! It looked promising after the first few lessons. Now the Univi icon was permanently black, even after removing and reinstalling. When I tried to open the app, the screen was black and couldn't operate anything! Thankfully rebooting my phone worked, but I already noticed at first glance that I need to reinstall at least my browser. I'm wondering what damage this app has done to my phone otherwise. Thankfully I had the sense to subscribe for one month only.
author: Gonny van de Straat
developer_reply:
Hi Gonny, I’m truly sorry for the trouble you’ve experienced. We’ve already fixed this bug. Please update the app, and if everything works well, I’d be incredibly grateful if you could update your review with more stars — it means so much to our small team. If you have any issues, feel free to email me at martyna@univi.app
Martyna, Univi Team
